title: The Garden Signal
learning_objectives: Use evidence from the story to explain a choice.
parent_prompts: Before reading: What do you notice in the title?
After reading: What helped the characters decide?

pages.text: Mai noticed that one row of bean plants looked droopy.
pages.audio_script: Mai noticed that one row of bean plants looked droopy.
pages.image_alt: Mai sees a row of drooping bean plants in the garden.

pages.text: Her little garden sensor showed a dry patch near the fence.
pages.audio_script: Her little garden sensor showed a dry patch near the fence.
pages.image_alt: A small sensor stands in dry soil beside the garden fence.

pages.text: But the soil beside the sensor felt damp to Mai.
pages.audio_script: But the soil beside the sensor felt damp to Mai.
pages.image_alt: Mai touches damp soil beside a garden sensor.

pages.text: She checked three places with her finger before watering anything.
pages.audio_script: She checked three places with her finger before watering anything.
pages.image_alt: Mai checks soil at several spots in the bean garden.

pages.text: Only the far corner was dry; the sensor had been moved.
pages.audio_script: Only the far corner was dry; the sensor had been moved.
pages.image_alt: Mai sees that the garden sensor has moved from the dry corner.

pages.text: Mai watered that corner and put the sensor back in place.
pages.audio_script: Mai watered that corner and put the sensor back in place.
pages.image_alt: Mai waters the dry corner and returns the sensor to its place.

pages.text: The next day, the leaves looked firm again.
pages.audio_script: The next day, the leaves looked firm again.
pages.image_alt: The bean leaves stand firm in the garden the next day.
